title: InferencePlannerInput
description: Inputs for OpenVibe.Host's inference placement planner (PLAN.md §D, §E and §G-P7). It forecasts a daily request series and compares the monthly cost of a warm rented GPU, scale-to-zero and wholesale for every model × GPU-class candidate. Every price is an integer nano-USD (D1). There is no action: this document can recommend a rental but never starts, stops or rents anything.

$schema.description: Optional editor association with this schema file.

note.description: Provenance, for example 'example, not a quote' or the quote ids and measurement dates.

horizon_days.description: Days to forecast after the last series point.

window_days.description: Trailing days used for the moving average and the day-of-week factors; not more than the series length.

series.description: Consecutive daily request counts, oldest first. Dates must be calendar days and every point must be the next day.

input_tokens.description: I: fresh input tokens per request.

cached_read_tokens.description: R: input tokens read from a prompt cache per request.

cache_write_tokens.description: W: input tokens written to a prompt cache per request.

output_tokens.description: O: generated output tokens per request.

models.description: Model candidates. Every model is paired with every GPU class.

id.description: Exact model id, for example qwen/qwen3-9b:q4_k_m@3f2a1c9.

prefill_tokens_per_sec.description: Measured prompt-processing throughput at the stated concurrency.

decode_tokens_per_sec.description: Measured output throughput at the stated concurrency.

cached_read_tokens_per_sec.description: Optional measured cached-read throughput; omitted means prefill throughput (conservative).

concurrency.description: Concurrency at which the throughput numbers were measured; recorded, not multiplied.

success_bps.description: Successful tasks per 10,000 requests (basis points), used for cost per successful task.

input_nano_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale input rate, nano-USD per million tokens.

cached_read_nano_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale cached-read rate, nano-USD per million tokens.

cache_write_nano_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale cache-write rate, nano-USD per million tokens.

output_nano_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale output rate, nano-USD per million tokens.

success_bps.description: Optional wholesale success rate in basis points; defaults to the model's success_bps.

gpu_classes.description: GPU classes. Every GPU class is paired with every model.

hourly_nano_usd.description: Rented warm GPU rate, nano-USD per GPU-hour.

storage_gb.description: Model storage held for the warm deployment, in GB (counted once per candidate).

egress_bytes_per_request.description: Response bytes sent per request (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes).

hourly_nano_usd.description: Serverless execution rate, nano-USD per GPU-hour of busy time.

startup_seconds.description: Cold-start seconds paid at the serverless hourly rate.

requests_per_cold_start.description: Requests served per cold start; one cold start is paid per this many requests.

storage_gb.description: Storage held for the scale-to-zero deployment, in GB.

nanoUsd.description: Integer nano-USD (D1). JSON numbers above 2^53 must be written as decimal strings to survive parsing; the planner accepts both.
